summary: Registers a kind of URI that represents a JSON Web Key (JWK) Thumbprint, as defined in RFC 7638. This lets a thumbprint be used, for example, as a key identifier in places that require a URI. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A key's thumbprint is like a fingerprint. This gives that fingerprint an address-style name so it can be used anywhere a web-style name is needed.

how to use a key thumbprint as a uri
